title: If Your Plan Denies Care, Appealing Is Worth Your Time
script:
Here's a number that should change how you respond if a plan says no. Only 11.5 percent of those 4.1 million denials were ever appealed.

That means most people simply didn't challenge the decision. They stopped at the first no.

But when people did appeal, 80.7 percent of those appeals were overturned. That is most of the appeals that were filed.

That doesn't prove every single denial was wrong. Keep that in mind when you look at the 80.7 percent figure.

But it tells you appealing is worth your time, and most people simply don't do it.

If your plan denies care, don't stop at the first no. Appealing can be worth your time. Watch the full video, link in the description.
